name: Domino Roads
description: Domino Roads is a western connecting domino game played with two double-six sets, enabling larger tables and longer layouts. Players build a shared layout by matching open ends while managing mobility and pip exposure under duplicated-tile uncertainty.

overview.description: Domino Roads is a western connecting domino game played with two double-six sets, enabling larger tables and longer layouts. Players build a shared layout by matching open ends while managing mobility and pip exposure under duplicated-tile uncertainty.

history.origins: Domino Roads is encountered as a modern connecting format that increases supply by combining two standard sets to reduce early blocking.
timeline: Modern era: circulated through social play and rules collections.
history.cultural: Played as a casual social game with scoring and blocked-turn rules chosen by the table.
history.evolution: Duplication changes end-control and inference, shifting play toward flexible connectors and safe exits.

setup.deck: Two double-6 domino sets combined and mixed.
setup.dealing: Deal tiles by player count; remaining tiles may form a boneyard by table profile.
setup.equipment: Domino sets and optional score tracking.

rules.objective: Play legal tiles by matching open ends and achieve the best score under the match profile when the hand ends.
rules.gameplay: Players place one tile per turn to a legal open end of the shared layout. If blocked, the table profile determines whether to draw from a boneyard or pass. A hand ends when a player empties their hand or when play is blocked, and the table profile determines how the hand is scored.
keyRules: A played tile must match the value of an exposed open end.
Blocked turns resolve according to the draw-or-pass profile.
Hand-end and scoring vary by table.

strategy.basic: Preserve mobility with flexible tiles and avoid holding high-pip tiles late.
strategy.intermediate: Because tiles are duplicated, choose lines that are robust even if opponents also have the same values.
strategy.advanced: Use end control to shape the layout into states that reduce opponent options while maintaining your own safe exits.
tips: Prefer moves that preserve multiple matching values in your hand.
Avoid narrowing the board to a value that only you can answer; duplication makes that plan fragile.

synthesis.shortDescription: Domino Roads is a two double-six set connecting game where duplicated tiles change blocking and end-control dynamics.
